svg.text: Study 007 — The Gaps, Not the Things
negative space: draw the ground, not the figure · seeded 7007
the vase is the part I didn't draw
Rubin's vase — figure and ground trade places
every leaf here is un-drawn paper — the ink draws only the sky between them
one leaf gets an outline, in vermilion, as the odd one out
the hole you can actually see through — negative space gives the eye a place to rest
What it taught: the eye finds an edge whether or not the pen touches it — leave the figure as paper, tone the ground, and the un-drawn shape reads first and clearest.
